bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
command -v ffprobe >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo FFPROBE_MISSING; exit 74; }
match=0; candidates=0
for p in /mnt/g /mnt/G /mnt/gdrive /media/g /home/gace/Project/Gserver/storage; do
 if test -d "$p"; then
  find "$p" -maxdepth 7 -type f -size +1300M -size -2000M -print 2>/dev/null | while IFS= read -r f; do
   duration="$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$f" 2>/dev/null || true)"
   if awk -v d="$duration" 'BEGIN {exit !(d>=2428&&d<=2432)}'; then echo MATCH_40M30_VIDEO; exit 41; fi
  done
 fi
done
echo NO_VERIFIED_40M30_OR_NO_FILE_ACCESS
exit 73
